about: Every English text the Orbit phone app can show, made by tools/i18n/extract.cjs: do not edit by hand. Each language's translations are in phone/ui/public/locales/<code>.json, keyed by these texts. kind: button (keep it short), heading, spoken (read out by screen readers), field (a hint in a text box), message (from Flutter, the TV or its scripts), text. A text with "one" is a count: the key is its "other" form.
